name: Ramie Fathy, MD
title: Dermatology Resident, AI Researcher, Writer
summary: Dermatology resident at Johns Hopkins. I build clinical AI tools and study how they should, and should not, be used at the bedside.
consoleIntro: building clinical AI tools. testing whether they belong at the bedside.
activity: evaluating vision-language models on dermoscopic images…
drafting a clinic note from live audio…
scheduling spaced repetition across the dermpath curriculum…
writing about what AI gets wrong at the bedside…

about.intro: I am completing my final year of dermatology residency at Johns Hopkins, with clinical interests in inflammatory and complex medical dermatology, dermatopathology, and clinical AI evaluation.
highlights: Incoming rheumatology-dermatology fellow at Mass General Brigham, joining Dr. Adam Rodman's research lab.
Princeton AB in Molecular Biology (Summa Cum Laude, Phi Beta Kappa); MD from Penn (Alpha Omega Alpha).
AAD Council on Science and Research (2025-2027); Johns Hopkins House Staff Council.
